purpose: Test whether the exact source EPS geometry survives an independent PostScript normalization path reproducibly enough to support a later machine topology reconstruction. This is a prerequisite diagnostic only, not an incidence embedding test or amplitude/refinement bridge.

implementation_frozen_rules.normalization: resize each cropped binary mask to 1024x1024 nearest-neighbor before cross-representation comparison

classification_rule.REPRESENTATION_STABLE: all 8 lanes valid; for each asset and dpi cross-representation normalized binary disagreement <=0.002 and foreground relative difference <=0.005; for each asset+representation filtered component count identical across 300/600 dpi
classification_rule.REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENT: all lanes valid but cross-representation threshold fails while each representation is internally dpi-stable
classification_rule.TOPOLOGY_EXTRACTION_UNSTABLE: all lanes valid but dpi component stability fails

interpretation_lock: Even REPRESENTATION_STABLE gives zero bridge credit and does not prove DED→DLD embedding. It only authorizes a separately preregistered incidence-graph extraction/embedding gate. No threshold retuning after outputs.
